name: ภาษีนำเข้า Shock Test
idea: Shows cross-border sellers how a tariff, VAT or port disruption changes landed cost and suggests new prices.
twist: Simulates Thai rules on low-value imports and compares China-sourced stock with Thai-made alternatives.
sources: TARIFFED! (Microsoft AI Agents Hackathon 2025 (virtual), Best Use of Azure AI Agent Service) — Trade tariff analyzer that helps users understand how import/export tariffs affect supply chains and pricing.

RiskWise (Microsoft AI Agents Hackathon 2025 (virtual), Best Overall) — Multi-agent supply chain risk analysis system that flags potential risks such as port delays and geopolitical events that could affect production or delivery.

name: บอทไม่มั่ว
idea: A second model checks every AI chat reply from a Shopee shop and blocks false warranty, stock or shipping promises.
twist: Checks Thai replies against the shop's own policy and stock, and catches polite-but-wrong Thai answers.
sources: ModelProof: Sentinel AI Chat (Microsoft AI Agents Hackathon 2025 (virtual), Best JavaScript/TypeScript Agent) — Trustworthiness validator that uses two language models to detect hallucinations, bias and toxicity in AI responses.

name: สูตรแม่ Keeper
idea: Records a family cook preparing dishes and turns tacit know-how into standard recipes and training cards for new staff.
twist: Converts 'ใส่พอประมาณ' into measured amounts from video, keeping taste consistent as a ShopeeFood kitchen grows.
sources: Konveyor (Microsoft AI Agents Hackathon 2025 (virtual), Best Python Agent) — Knowledge transfer agent that conveys organizational knowledge from where it resides to where it is needed.

name: เลขบัตรปลอม Test Data
idea: Generates realistic synthetic Thai customer data for testing fintech and e-commerce systems without real personal data.
twist: Produces valid-checksum Thai ID numbers, real tambon addresses and Thai name spellings for PDPA-safe testing.
sources: Avalon (UiPath AgentHack 2025 (global, online), Agentic Testing 1st place) — Agent that generates synthetic test data for test orchestration.

name: พัสดุหาย Agent Network
idea: Seller, courier and buyer agents negotiate a lost-parcel case together, sharing evidence until one settlement is agreed.
twist: Each agent follows its party's Thai platform rules, so cases close without three-way phone tag.
sources: Agent Halo Agent Networks (Salesforce TDX 2025 Agentforce Hackathon, San Francisco, 1st place) — Agentforce agent network connecting insurers, repair shops and emergency responders to remove delays in the customer claims journey.

name: งานทีละขั้น
idea: Turns packing and café tasks into picture-by-picture spoken steps for workers with cognitive disabilities.
twist: Built for Thai social-enterprise cafés and Shopee packing jobs, working offline on a cheap phone.
sources: Vite Vere Offline (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), 2nd place) — Offline digital companion that turns images into simple read-aloud instructions to foster autonomy for people with cognitive disabilities.

name: พูดได้ Order
idea: Stroke survivors with slurred speech order food and pay by voice using a model tuned to their own speech.
twist: Learns Thai tones from a short personal recording session, since slurred Thai tones change word meaning.
sources: Dream Assistant (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), Unsloth Prize) — Custom voice assistant trained on an individual's recordings to understand the unique speech patterns of users with speech impairments.

name: ห้องเรียนดอย
idea: An offline school server gives a hill-area school a tutor, lesson library and progress tracking without internet.
twist: Bridges Karen or Hmong home languages to Thai curriculum and syncs reports when a teacher reaches signal.
sources: LENTERA (Google Gemma 3n Impact Challenge 2025 (Kaggle, online), Ollama Prize) — Offline educational microserver on affordable hardware for remote and disconnected rural regions.

name: KidBright Blocks
idea: Students build projects with visual blocks and the AI writes and explains the real microcontroller code behind them.
twist: Targets the KidBright boards already in Thai schools, with Thai explanations and local projects like smart rice-drying.
sources: Elisa (Anthropic Built with Opus 4.6 Claude Code Hackathon 2026 (virtual), 2nd place) — Visual block-based IDE that generates microcontroller code behind the scenes so middle schoolers can learn programming without writing code.

name: ช่างราคาแฟร์
idea: Homeowners photograph a leak or broken air-con, get likely causes and a fair price range, then a vetted technician.
twist: Checks contractor history against public records to avoid builders who take deposits and disappear.
sources: MaestrIA (Anthropic Built with Opus 4.7 Claude Code Hackathon 2026 (virtual), Keep Thinking Prize) — Home repair diagnostic tool that gives cost/time estimates and connects users with local skilled tradespeople.

SafeContractor (BU Spark! Civic Tech Hackathon 2025, Overall Winner, Boston) — Database where Boston residents verify contractor credentials from public records, with AI-generated summaries to avoid fraud.

name: Carbon Slip for Exporters
idea: Builds a carbon and ESG report for small exporters from invoices, electricity bills and shipping records.
twist: Prepares Thai SMEs for EU buyer questionnaires using Thai grid emission factors and supplier data.
sources: Tese (G20 TechSprint 2024 (BIS & Banco Central do Brasil), winner, Brazil) — Builds ESG dashboards that streamline sustainability reporting for small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: สิทธิ์คนพิการ Filer
idea: Helps people with disabilities and families gather evidence and file disability card and allowance applications correctly.
twist: Maps medical certificates to Thai disability categories and lists what the local office will ask for.
sources: Vet's Claim (Stanford CodeX LLM x Law Hackathon 2024 (spring), Best Overall, Stanford) — AI chatbot that helps veterans gather information and file accurate VA disability claims using VA regulations and 20 years of case findings.

name: รูปโดนขโมย
idea: Finds Shopee shops reusing a seller's product photos and assesses copyright infringement risk.
twist: Drafts a Thai takedown request with evidence of original upload time and image similarity.
sources: Warhol (Stanford CodeX LLM x Law Hackathon 2026 (FutureLaw Week), Harvey Challenge Award, Stanford) — Uses vision models to find visually similar images online and applies copyright law and case law to assess infringement risk.

name: OPD Twin
idea: A digital twin of a community hospital's outpatient flow finds the bottleneck behind long waits and tests fixes.
twist: Models Thai OPD steps like vital-signs queue and pharmacy, then tests moving refills to รพ.สต. pickup.
sources: HospiTwin (MIT Hacking Medicine 2025, InterSystems Best Use of GenAI in Healthcare prize, Boston) — Digital twin of an emergency department floor that identifies the bottlenecks causing long patient wait times.

name: ไม่เผาอ้อย Advisor
idea: A voice advisor helps sugarcane and corn farmers plan harvest without burning, comparing cost and buyer options.
twist: Links to nearby harvester rental and biomass buyers so the no-burn plan is cheaper, not just greener.
sources: Field Advisor (FAO Reboot the Earth Hackathon 2025, 2nd place, Rome) — Voice-powered RAG assistant giving farmers localized advice on crop selection, soil management and pest control for climate-resilient decisions.
